notes: IVA 13% (Ley 9635, art. 10, La Gaceta text). The complete art. 8 exemption and art. 9 non-subjection lists were read in the gazette text: gold and precious metals appear in neither, and the reduced rates in art. 11 do not mention them; art. 19 lists jewellery and gold objects among purchases with no input credit (except habitual dealers). Duty null (tariff is an interactive system).

sources.name: La Gaceta (Imprenta Nacional) - Ley 9635, Ley del IVA, art. 10 (gazette PDF hosted on uned.cr)
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: the IVA rate is 13% for all taxable operations; the art. 8/9 lists read in full contain no gold or precious-metals item
sources.quote: Artículo 10- Tarifa del impuesto — La tarifa del impuesto es del trece por ciento (13%) para todas las operaciones sujetas al pago del impuesto, de acuerdo con lo previsto en el artículo 1 de esta ley.
